summary: dnf options: allow_downgrade (may be non-idempotent), allowerasing to resolve conflicts, autoremove of leaf packages, best version behavior, bugfix-only updates, and cacheonly.
questions: How do I let dnf remove conflicting packages to install something?
How do I apply only bugfix updates with Ansible?
How do I run dnf without refreshing metadata?
How do I remove orphaned dependencies with dnf?
How do I downgrade a package with the dnf module?

answer_card.title: dnf parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `allow_downgrade` (no): permit downgrade; can be non-idempotent; careful with wildcards
- `allowerasing` (no): erase installed packages to resolve deps
- `autoremove` (no): remove unneeded leaf deps; use alone or with `state=absent`
- `best`: true = highest version or fail; false = fall back; default from distro
- `bugfix` (no): with `state=latest`, only bugfix updates
- `cacheonly` (no): use cache only
